stats AS (
    SELECT
        COUNT(p."id") AS total_posts,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN p."score" > 50 THEN 1 END) AS posts_above_50
    FROM "posts" p
    JOIN top_user tu ON p."owneruserid" = tu."id"

    (stats.posts_above_50::NUMERIC / NULLIF(stats.total_posts, 0)) * 100 AS percentage
FROM stats;

    ec."colour" AS eye_colour,
    hc."colour" AS hair_colour,
    sc."colour" AS skin_colour
FROM "superhero" s
JOIN "gender" g ON g."id" = s."gender_id"
JOIN "publisher" p ON p."id" = s."publisher_id"
LEFT JOIN "colour" ec ON ec."id" = s."eye_colour_id"
LEFT JOIN "colour" hc ON hc."id" = s."hair_colour_id"
LEFT JOIN "colour" sc ON sc."id" = s."skin_colour_id"
WHERE g."gender" = 'Female'
  AND p."publisher_name" = 'Dark Horse Comics';
834:
SELECT
    (SUM(CASE WHEN g."gender" = 'Female' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::numeric
     / COUNT(*)::numeric) * 100.0 AS percentage
FROM "superhero" s
JOIN "publisher" p ON p."id" = s."publisher_id"
JOIN "gender" g ON g."id" = s."gender_id"
WHERE p."publisher_name" LIKE '%George Lucas%'
819:
SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN c.id = 7 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
    - SUM(CASE WHEN c.id = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS difference
FROM "superhero" s
LEFT JOIN "colour" c ON s."eye_colour_id" = c."id"
WHERE s."weight_kg" = 0 OR s."weight_kg" IS NULL;
773:
SELECT DISTINCT
    s."superhero_name",
    p."publisher_name"
FROM "superhero" s
JOIN "publisher" p ON p."id" = s."publisher_id"
WHERE s."eye_colour_id" = s."hair_colour_id"
  AND s."hair_colour_id" = s."skin_colour_id"
  AND s."eye_colour_id" IS NOT NULL
  AND s."hair_colour_id" IS NOT NULL
  AND s."skin_colour_id" IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY s."superhero_name" ASC NULLS FIRST;
1342:

1388:

1456:

1340:
SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM e."event_date") = 2019 THEN b."spent" ELSE 0 END)
    - SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM e."event_date") = 2020 THEN b."spent" ELSE 0 END) AS difference
FROM event e
JOIN budget b ON b."link_to_event" = e."event_id"
WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM e."event_date") IN (2019, 2020);

1339:

1359:
WITH kickoff AS (
    SELECT SUM(b."amount") AS total
    FROM "budget" b
    JOIN "event" e ON b."link_to_event" = e."event_id"
    WHERE b."category" = 'Advertisement'
      AND e."event_name" LIKE '%Yearly Kickoff%'
),

october AS (
    SELECT SUM(b."amount") AS total
    FROM "budget" b
    JOIN "event" e ON b."link_to_event" = e."event_id"
    WHERE b."category" = 'Advertisement'
      AND e."event_name" LIKE '%October Meeting%'
)

SELECT k.total / o.total AS ratio
FROM kickoff k
CROSS JOIN october o;
1429:
SELECT DISTINCT e."event_name"
FROM "event" e
JOIN "attendance" a ON a."link_to_event" = e."event_id"
JOIN "member" m ON m."member_id" = a."link_to_member"
WHERE e."type" = 'Social'
  AND m."position" LIKE '%Vice President%'
  AND m."link_to_major" IS NOT NULL
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM "major" mj
    WHERE mj."major_id" = m."link_to_major"
      AND mj."college" LIKE '%Student_Club%'
  )
  AND m."zip" IN (
    SELECT z."zip_code"
    FROM "zip_code" z
    WHERE z."city" LIKE '%900 E. Washington St.%'
       OR z."county" LIKE '%900 E. Washington St.%'
       OR z."state" LIKE '%900 E. Washington St.%'
  );
1437:
SELECT DISTINCT
    m."first_name",
    m."last_name",
    a."link_to_event"
FROM "member" m
JOIN "expense" e
    ON e."link_to_member" = m."member_id"
JOIN "attendance" a
    ON a."link_to_member" = m."member_id"
WHERE e."approved" = 'true'
  AND e."expense_date"::date BETWEEN DATE '2019-01-10' AND DATE '2019-11-19'
ORDER BY m."first_name" ASC NULLS FIRST, m."last_name" ASC NULLS FIRST, a."link_to_event" ASC NULLS FIRST;
1448:
SELECT DISTINCT
    e."event_name",
    e."event_date"
FROM "event" e
JOIN "budget" b ON b."link_to_event" = e."event_id"
JOIN "expense" ex ON ex."link_to_budget" = b."budget_id"
WHERE ex."expense_description" LIKE '%Pizza%'
  AND ex."cost" > 50
  AND ex."cost" < 100
ORDER BY e."event_date" ASC NULLS FIRST;
1451:
SELECT m."first_name", m."last_name", e."cost"
FROM member m
JOIN expense e ON e."link_to_member" = m."member_id"
JOIN budget b ON b."budget_id" = e."link_to_budget"
WHERE m."member_id" IN (
    
    SELECT e2."link_to_member"
    FROM expense e2
    JOIN budget b2 ON b2."budget_id" = e2."link_to_budget"
    GROUP BY e2."link_to_member"
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT b2."link_to_event") > 1
)
ORDER BY e."cost" DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 1;
